author: NASASpaceflight
description:
NASA’s Artemis program advances as the massive SLS Core Stage for Artemis III rolls out of Michoud for its journey to Kennedy Space Center, while the Mobile Launcher is already being refurbished after a successful Artemis II mission. However, a new NASA OIG report warns that Axiom’s xEVAS spacesuit development could push crewed lunar landings into the 2030s. This episode also covers Voyager 1’s latest instrument shutdown, Blue Origin’s New Glenn struggling with second-stage orbit insertion on its third flight, SpaceX retiring droneship Just Read The Instructions for Starship transport duties, and Curiosity rover’s detection of new organic molecules on Mars—including a nitrogen heterocycle. Plus: full FY2027 NASA budget details, Jared Isaacman’s congressional hearing, ESA’s Space Rider test model completion, Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope progress, and this week’s global launch recap.
